biotools.summary: A web-based tool that converts open-source eLabFTW electronic laboratory notebook records into Annotated Research Contexts (ARCs). It automatically retrieves and reorganizes metadata, protocols, and attachments into ISA-compliant, FAIR digital objects.
biotools.name: elab2ARC
